The final resting image shows only the floor, so the ball is probably just under or beside the front of the feet, not visible to the cameras. I didn't get a clean close-up of it at rest, so the "close and facing" part is based on the view before that last step.

A note on the search: the ball was not straight ahead of the robot's starting pose. I first saw it at about 115° to the left of the heading the robot had then, which is behind the starting direction. I turned and walked to it anyway, since it's the only red ball I found in the room.

The robot is resting in a crouch with motors off. Battery is at 82%.
